svg.aria-label: DeepFeed AI system architecture: a Next.js frontend behind an Nginx reverse proxy calls a FastAPI backend; the API layer routes into application services; a user-triggered Discover Now action runs the discovery, processing and ranking pipeline synchronously in-request, while scheduled runs go through Celery Beat, RabbitMQ queues and Celery workers asynchronously; both paths write to the same PostgreSQL and pgvector store; a LangGraph-based research agent runs as a traced node graph on top of an LLM router spanning Anthropic, OpenAI and Gemini.
svg.text: TypeScript · Tailwind · TanStack Query · React 18 (SSR + client)
Zustand auth store, persisted — a hasHydrated gate stops a logged-in user bouncing to /login before rehydration finishes.
Axios client (relative /api) — 15-minute access token; a 401 triggers one silent refresh via the refresh token before logging out.
TLS termination (prod) · security headers · request routing
Next.js also self-proxies /api/* in local dev via next.config.js rewrites — same effect, no CORS either way.
9 routers · JWT auth via a shared get_current_user dependency · Argon2 password hashing
fired when the user clicks “Discover Now”
checks daily quota + cooldown · resolves the latest SearchPlan
source adapters fetch → dedupe → extract & enrich
scores by relevance · credibility · freshness, persists results
outcome returned in the same HTTP response
The worker container has restarted independently of the API in production — twice.
task_acks_late redelivery never recovered the in-flight run; the row stayed “running” forever.
A blocking call is slower, but it fails honestly instead of losing the work silently.
DiscoveryService · RankingService · AdaptationEngine — off the request path
marks a run failed after 600s stuck — worker restarts still happen
Decoupling from the request doesn’t remove the failure mode — a dead worker still orphans a task.
max_retries=3 with backoff covers transient errors, not a worker that never comes back.
The stale-run watchdog (600s) is the safety net redelivery alone couldn’t provide.
both paths persist through the same repositories
Swap or add a provider without touching a single service — the hexagonal boundary between domain and infra.
Used by the research agent and by the adaptation / reflection agents for summarization and scoring.
Single source of truth for both the synchronous and the scheduled pipeline.
One trace_id follows a request from Nginx through the API into a Celery task.
invoked from the /agent routes by ResearchPlanningAgent · every node emits its own OpenTelemetry span
iterate until evidence is strong enough
